FROM IV AS i
LEFT JOIN ARPaymentKnockOff AS ko
  ON ko.InvoiceDocKey = i.DocKey
LEFT JOIN ARPayment AS p
  ON p.DocKey = ko.PaymentDocKey
 AND p.Cancelled <> 'T'
WHERE i.Cancelled <> 'T'
GROUP BY i.DocKey
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.DocKey IS NOT NULL THEN ko.Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) < i.TotalIncTax;

items.question: Which customer owes us the most on unpaid, non-cancelled invoices?
items.author: team

B0.sql:
WITH credit_notes AS (
    SELECT
        InvoiceDocKey,
        SUM(TotalIncTax) AS CreditNoteAmount
    FROM CN
    WHERE Cancelled <> 'T'
    GROUP BY InvoiceDocKey
),
payments AS (
    SELECT
        k.InvoiceDocKey,
        SUM(k.Amount) AS PaidAmount
    FROM ARPaymentKnockOff k
    JOIN ARPayment p
        ON p.DocKey = k.PaymentDocKey
       AND p.Cancelled <> 'T'
    GROUP BY k.InvoiceDocKey
),
invoice_balances AS (
    SELECT
        i.DebtorCode,
        i.DocKey,
        i.TotalIncTax
            - COALESCE(c.CreditNoteAmount, 0)
            - COALESCE(p.PaidAmount, 0) AS OutstandingAmount
    FROM IV i
    LEFT JOIN credit_notes c
        ON c.InvoiceDocKey = i.DocKey
    LEFT JOIN payments p
        ON p.InvoiceDocKey = i.DocKey
    WHERE i.Cancelled <> 'T'
)
SELECT
    d.AccNo AS DebtorCode,
    d.CompanyName,
    SUM(ib.OutstandingAmount) AS AmountOwed
FROM invoice_balances ib
JOIN Debtor d
    ON d.AccNo = ib.DebtorCode
WHERE ib.OutstandingAmount > 0
GROUP BY d.AccNo, d.CompanyName
ORDER BY AmountOwed DESC
LIMIT 1;

items.question: How many customers have unpaid invoices overdue by more than 90 days, as of the latest invoice date?
items.author: team

B0.sql:
WITH latest_invoice AS (
    SELECT MAX(DocDate) AS latest_invoice_date
    FROM IV
    WHERE Cancelled <> 'T'
),
invoice_balances AS (
    SELECT
        i.DocKey,
        i.DebtorCode,
        i.DueDate,
        i.TotalIncTax,
        i.TotalIncTax - COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN p.Cancelled <> 'T' THEN k.Amount
                ELSE 0
            END
        ), 0) AS outstanding_amount
    FROM IV AS i
    LEFT JOIN ARPaymentKnockOff AS k
        ON k.InvoiceDocKey = i.DocKey
    LEFT JOIN ARPayment AS p
        ON p.DocKey = k.PaymentDocKey
    WHERE i.Cancelled <> 'T'
    GROUP BY
        i.DocKey,
        i.DebtorCode,
        i.DueDate,
        i.TotalIncTax
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ib.DebtorCode) AS overdue_customer_count
FROM invoice_balances AS ib
CROSS JOIN latest_invoice AS li
WHERE ib.outstanding_amount > 0
  AND date(ib.DueDate) < date(li.latest_invoice_date, '-90 days');

B1.sql:
WITH latest_invoice AS (
    SELECT MAX(DocDate) AS LatestDate
    FROM IV
    WHERE Cancelled <> 'T'
),
paid_by_invoice AS (
    SELECT
        k.InvoiceDocKey,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.Cancelled <> 'T' THEN k.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS PaidAmount
    FROM ARPaymentKnockOff AS k
    JOIN ARPayment AS p
        ON p.DocKey = k.PaymentDocKey
    GROUP BY k.InvoiceDocKey
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.DebtorCode) AS CustomerCount
FROM IV AS i
CROSS JOIN latest_invoice AS l
LEFT JOIN paid_by_invoice AS paid
    ON paid.InvoiceDocKey = i.DocKey
WHERE i.Cancelled <> 'T'
  AND date(i.DueDate) < date(l.LatestDate, '-90 days')
  AND i.TotalIncTax > COALESCE(paid.PaidAmount, 0);

WITH latest_invoice AS (
    SELECT MAX(DocDate) AS latest_invoice_date
    FROM IV
    WHERE Cancelled <> 'T'
),
invoice_balances AS (
    SELECT
        i.DocKey,
        i.DebtorCode,
        i.DueDate,
        i.TotalIncTax,
        i.TotalIncTax - COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN p.Cancelled <> 'T' THEN k.Amount
                ELSE 0
            END
        ), 0) AS outstanding_amount
    FROM IV AS i
    LEFT JOIN ARPaymentKnockOff AS k
        ON k.InvoiceDocKey = i.DocKey
    LEFT JOIN ARPayment AS p
        ON p.DocKey = k.PaymentDocKey
    WHERE i.Cancelled <> 'T'
    GROUP BY
        i.DocKey,
        i.DebtorCode,
        i.DueDate,
        i.TotalIncTax
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ib.DebtorCode) AS overdue_customer_count
FROM invoice_balances AS ib
CROSS JOIN latest_invoice AS li
WHERE ib.outstanding_amount > 0
  AND date(ib.DueDate) < date(li.latest_invoice_date, '-90 days');

B3.sql:
WITH latest_invoice AS (
    SELECT MAX(DocDate) AS LatestDocDate
    FROM IV
    WHERE Cancelled <> 'T'
),
paid_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        ko.InvoiceDocKey,
        SUM(ko.Amount) AS PaidAmount
    FROM ARPaymentKnockOff ko
    JOIN ARPayment p
        ON p.DocKey = ko.PaymentDocKey
    WHERE p.Cancelled <> 'T'
    GROUP BY ko.InvoiceDocKey
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.DebtorCode) AS CustomerCount
FROM IV i
CROSS JOIN latest_invoice li
LEFT JOIN paid_amounts pa
    ON pa.InvoiceDocKey = i.DocKey
WHERE i.Cancelled <> 'T'
  AND i.DueDate < date(li.LatestDocDate, '-90 days')
  AND i.TotalIncTax - COALESCE(pa.PaidAmount, 0) > 0;
